description: Two-pass drift-measurement plan for R3.3: pass 1 realizes and parses-back the nested fixture items (see nested-coverage-manifest.json); pass 2 realizes and parses-back the ITEMS PRODUCED BY PASS 1 (each item's pass-1 parsedText becomes pass-2's sourceText), so drift across two full round trips can be measured by diffing pass-1 vs pass-2 parsedText per item.
chainingGapNote: The retention manifest schema (openlunum-retention-manifest/0.1, see retention-manifest.ts) and runRetentionCli (retention-cli.ts) have NO mechanism to feed one pass's output into the next pass's input. runRetentionCli's realizationPrompt() always reads item.sourceText from the STATIC dataset named in manifest.dataset.path; the 'attempt' dimension (limits.maxAttemptsPerItem) is a same-input RETRY loop that breaks on the first passed attempt, not a chain -- attempt 2 re-realizes the ORIGINAL item, it never sees attempt 1's parsedText. Automating real chaining would require: (1) a `pass` field on RetentionStageRawRecord distinct from `attempt`, so per-pass records are queryable without conflating retries and chained passes; (2) a manifest-level `passes: number` (or an explicit list of per-pass dataset refs) validated by validateRetentionManifest; (3) runtime logic in runRetentionCli that, after a passed parse-back in pass N, derives pass N+1's per-item sourceText from pass N's parsedText instead of re-reading the static dataset, and re-validates that derived input before use; (4) NO new scoring/threshold logic is required for the chaining mechanism itself -- drift measurement (diffing pass-1 vs pass-2 parsedText) is a separate, later analysis step over the raw JSONL and is explicitly out of this issue's scope (R3.3 constraints: do not touch retention scoring logic). This gap is why pass 2 below is a VALIDATED TEMPLATE, not an executable chain: its dataset currently points at the same static pass-1 input as a schema-valid placeholder. Before pass 2 can measure real drift, its dataset.path/dataset.sha256 must be replaced by regenerating a dataset file from pass 1's actual reports/evaluations/retention/<run>/raw/parse-back.jsonl output (mapping each item's parsedText to the next dataset's sourceText) -- a manual or scripted step that does not yet exist and is NOT implemented by this issue, per instruction to report rather than build undescribed pipeline behavior.

passes.inputSource: PLACEHOLDER: must be regenerated from pass 1's raw parse-back.jsonl output before this pass can be executed for real (see chainingGapNote) -- currently repeats the pass-1 static dataset so this manifest is schema-valid and independently runnable, not so it measures real second-pass drift
